notes: eDP does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The interoperability-relevant facts are the DPCD capability registers (DPCD_REV, MAX_LINK_RATE, MAX_LANE_COUNT) plus the eDP-specific block (eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP / eDP_GENERAL_CAP advertising ASSR / Fast Link Training / PSR / backlight) read over AUX, and the panel EDID read by I2C-over-AUX; an implementation may back these with ROM/fuses, but the spec only requires they be discoverable.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: DPCD revision advertised by the panel Sink.
Maximum Main Link rate the panel supports (RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3).
eDP revision and capability flags (ASSR, Fast Link Training, PSR / PSR2, backlight adjustment, frame-buffer).

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.location: Panel I2C ROM (I2C address A0h, via I2C-over-AUX)
otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Panel capability/timing descriptor; factory-programmed in the panel.
